title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei
snippet: News article highlighting Professor Fabio Giglietto's research into Meta's political content reduction policies, detailing how algorithmic suppression disproportionately penalized mainstream politicians compared to fringe accounts.
description: An Italian news article reporting on a study led by Professor Fabio Giglietto at the University of Urbino regarding the impact of Facebook's algorithm on political content and anti-European extremism.
